about: 8 live checks of the data path behind 'where can I camp for free near <town>?'. They run scripts/near_town.py in this same process. They test our records and the script, not a language model. A town's count changes when the records are rebuilt, so the checks never pin a count: they test that camps exist, that each one is free on its record, that each record link answers 200, and that the envelope keeps its five keys.
